es: Matizar hallazgos rotundos con estructuras impersonales: there is some evidence that, it appears that, it remains unclear whether, to some extent.

teaching.en: It remains unclear whether the new timetable improves sleep, because the evidence so far is not conclusive and covers only one school.
teaching.es: Sigue sin estar claro si el nuevo horario mejora el sueño, porque las pruebas hasta ahora no son concluyentes y cubren un solo colegio.
teaching.explanationEs: It remains unclear whether + cláusula: todavía no hay respuesta. Con la duda se usa whether, no that.
segments: It remains unclear whether the new timetable improves sleep, because the
evidence so far is not conclusive and covers only one school.
teaching.audioText: It remains unclear whether the new timetable improves sleep, because the evidence so far is not conclusive and covers only one school.

teaching.en: There is some tentative evidence that longer sleep improves concentration, but the studies are small, so a degree of caution is needed.
teaching.es: Hay algunas pruebas provisionales de que dormir más mejora la concentración, pero los estudios son pequeños, así que hace falta cierta cautela.
teaching.explanationEs: There is some evidence that… admite que hay datos, pero débiles. Evidence es incontable: no lleva -s.
segments: There is some tentative evidence that longer sleep improves concentration, but
the studies are small, so a degree of caution is needed.
teaching.audioText: There is some tentative evidence that longer sleep improves concentration, but the studies are small, so a degree of caution is needed.

teaching.en: To a certain extent, the results are explained by the later start of lessons, although they are largely based on what students said.
teaching.es: Hasta cierto punto, los resultados se explican por el inicio más tardío de las clases, aunque se basan en gran medida en lo que dijeron los estudiantes.
teaching.explanationEs: To a certain extent (o to some extent) limita el alcance de la afirmación; largely reduce la fuerza de la base de datos.
segments: To a certain extent, the results are explained by the later start
of lessons, although they are largely based on what students said.
teaching.audioText: To a certain extent, the results are explained by the later start of lessons, although they are largely based on what students said.

teaching.en: It appears that screen time affects sleep, but a small sample could easily call into question a result that looks convincing at first.
teaching.es: Parece que el tiempo de pantalla afecta al sueño, pero una muestra pequeña podría poner en duda fácilmente un resultado que al principio resulta convincente.
teaching.explanationEs: It appears that… introduce una inferencia prudente; call into question significa poner en duda.
segments: It appears that screen time affects sleep, but a small sample could
easily call into question a result that looks convincing at first.
teaching.audioText: It appears that screen time affects sleep, but a small sample could easily call into question a result that looks convincing at first.

teaching.en: The data indicate that most students sleep too little, but the survey was somewhat limited, so the authors ask readers to interpret it carefully.
teaching.es: Los datos indican que la mayoría de los estudiantes duerme muy poco, pero la encuesta fue algo limitada, así que los autores piden a los lectores que la interpreten con cuidado.
teaching.explanationEs: Indicate es más fuerte que appears; somewhat suaviza una crítica al método.
segments: The data indicate that most students sleep too little, but the survey
was somewhat limited, so the authors ask readers to interpret it carefully.
teaching.audioText: The data indicate that most students sleep too little, but the survey was somewhat limited, so the authors ask readers to interpret it carefully.

teaching.en: Headlines such as 'Screens ruin sleep' are much too strong, so a careful report turns them into statements that match the evidence.
teaching.es: Titulares como «Las pantallas arruinan el sueño» son demasiado fuertes, así que un informe cuidadoso los convierte en enunciados que se ajustan a las pruebas.
teaching.explanationEs: Ruin es un verbo rotundo; el informe lo sustituye por estructuras matizadas como there is some evidence that…

prompt.es: Elige la reformulación que ajusta el grado de certeza a los datos de la encuesta.

choices.text: It is clear that late screen use is the reason why students sleep less.
There is some evidence that late screen use may be linked to shorter sleep.
It is unclear why students use screens late, since they sleep so little.

feedback.es: La encuesta solo halló un vínculo en un colegio: There is some evidence that… y may admiten esa base débil sin afirmar una causa.

hint.es: El estudio solo halló un vínculo en un colegio: busca la estructura que admite una prueba débil.

origin.text: Draft finding: 'Late screen use ruins students' sleep.' However, the survey of 120 students only found that those who use screens late sleep less. It did not measure the reason, and it covered one school.

prompt.es: Completa: «Aún no está claro si el nuevo horario mejora el sueño.»

feedback.es: Tras unclear se introduce la duda con whether (o if), no con that.

hint.es: Es la conjunción que introduce una duda entre dos posibilidades: sí o no.

origin.text: The study has only just started and the first results are not yet available. It remains unclear ___ the new timetable improves sleep.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Hasta cierto punto, los resultados se explican por el inicio más tardío.»

answer.text: To a certain extent the results are explained by the later start

feedback.es: To a certain extent limita el alcance: el inicio más tardío explica solo una parte de los resultados.

hint.es: Empieza por el matizador que significa «hasta cierto punto».

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué concluye la investigadora sobre el cambio de horario.

choices.text: That later lessons clearly improve concentration in every school.
That the survey proves that the effect will last a whole year.
That more research is needed before schools change their timetables.

feedback.es: La investigadora admite que solo hay indicios débiles y pide un estudio mayor antes de cambiar horarios.

origin.audio: A researcher is summing up her study for the school newspaper. There is some tentative evidence that students who start lessons later concentrate better, but she is careful. Only one school took part, and the survey was somewhat limited. It remains unclear whether the effect would last over a whole year. She therefore calls for a larger study before any school changes its timetable.

prompt.es: Reescribe con matiz: «Homework ruins students' free time.»

answer.text: There is some evidence that homework may reduce students' free time, although it remains unclear how much.
accepted: There is some evidence that homework may reduce students' free time, although it remains unclear how much.
There is some evidence that homework can reduce students' free time, but it is unclear how large the effect is.
There is some evidence that homework tends to reduce students' free time, although the survey was somewhat limited.

feedback.es: La frase lleva There is some evidence that… más una segunda cautela (may, tends to, it remains unclear) y evita el verbo rotundo ruin.

origin.text: Hallazgo rotundo: «Homework ruins students' free time.» Reescríbelo para un informe con There is some evidence that… y una segunda cautela (may, it remains unclear…).

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué critica exactamente el lector del informe.

choices.text: That the headline is stronger than the findings below it.
That the findings section contains figures that are wrong.
That the authors have hidden the size of the effect.

feedback.es: El lector acepta los resultados del informe, pero critica que el titular sea más rotundo que lo que los datos permiten.

origin.audio: The school's sleep report has been praised, but one reader wrote in with a criticism. According to his letter, the authors wrote in their headline that screens ruin sleep, yet their own findings section says something much weaker: it appears that screen use may be linked to shorter sleep, and it remains unclear whether the effect is large. The reader does not accuse the authors of lying. He simply thinks that a headline should match the evidence below it, and that a careful report would have said there is some evidence that screens affect sleep.

prompt.es: Con el mismo audio, elige cómo habría redactado el lector el titular.

choices.text: With a bolder verb, so that more people would read it.
With a cautious hedge, such as there is some evidence that.
With no verb at all, using only the figures.

feedback.es: El lector sugiere que un informe cuidadoso habría dicho there is some evidence that screens affect sleep.

origin.audio: The school's sleep report has been praised, but one reader wrote in with a criticism. According to his letter, the authors wrote in their headline that screens ruin sleep, yet their own findings section says something much weaker: it appears that screen use may be linked to shorter sleep, and it remains unclear whether the effect is large. The reader does not accuse the authors of lying. He simply thinks that a headline should match the evidence below it, and that a careful report would have said there is some evidence that screens affect sleep.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los resultados se basan en gran medida en lo que dijo un grupo pequeño.»

feedback.es: Largely based on indica que la base de datos es, en su mayor parte, lo que dijo un grupo pequeño.

origin.text: The survey asked only students from one school, so the results are ___ based on what a small group said. A wider study would be needed to confirm them.

prompt.es: Reescribe el hallazgo con «It appears that» y una cautela más.

answer.text: It appears that students who eat breakfast tend to get better grades, although it remains unclear whether breakfast is the cause.
accepted: It appears that students who eat breakfast tend to get better grades, although it remains unclear whether breakfast is the cause.
It appears that students who have breakfast may get better grades, but it is unclear whether breakfast explains the difference.
It appears that students who eat breakfast tend to get better grades, although the evidence is not conclusive.

feedback.es: It appears that… introduce el hallazgo con prudencia y la segunda cautela (tend to, it remains unclear whether, not conclusive) evita afirmar una causa.

origin.text: Hallazgo rotundo: «Students who eat breakfast get better grades.» Reescríbelo para un informe con It appears that… y una cautela adicional (tend to, it remains unclear whether…).

prompt.es: Lee el párrafo y elige qué afirmación se formula con más certeza.

choices.text: A later start would probably change how much students sleep.
The answer may depend on how students spend their evenings.
Most students sleep too little, according to the data.

feedback.es: The data indicate… es la fórmula más firme del párrafo; it remains unclear y may marcan dudas sobre el efecto del horario.

origin.text: Extract from a report: 'The data indicate that seventy percent of students sleep too little. It remains unclear whether a later start would change that, and to a certain extent the answer may depend on how students spend their evenings.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le pide la tutora a la estudiante.

choices.text: To replace a firm claim with a more careful one.
To add more figures about the loans in the library.
To remove the library from the essay completely.

feedback.es: La tutora propone sustituir proves por una fórmula prudente, porque los préstamos no demuestran que se lea más.

origin.audio: My tutor returned my essay with a comment: you write that the new library proves that students read more. The figures only indicate a rise in loans, and it remains unclear whether people actually read the books. She suggested this instead: there is some evidence that loans have risen, which may reflect more reading.

prompt.es: Completa: «La encuesta fue algo limitada, así que los resultados son provisionales.»

feedback.es: Somewhat suaviza la crítica: la encuesta tiene límites, pero no se descarta por completo.

origin.text: The survey was ___ limited, so the authors describe their findings as tentative rather than final. They also say that more data are needed.
